verdict.rationale: Twilio's own docs say its APIs can be used through official Twilio SDKs for several programming languages, and they name a specific Voice JavaScript SDK, so building against first-party SDKs is directly documented. The evidence is thin on breadth and depth. missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages and their maturity, in-depth SDK reference documentation in the pack, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality specifically (as opposed to the API generally).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can use the APIs directly over HTTPS or through Twilio SDKs available for several programming languages.
